render.description: Which renderer draws. Every key is optional; a key left out says nothing, so the layer below decides.

backend.description: auto (the default) picks by hardware; or name a backend.

fallback.description: Step down to a lighter backend if the chosen one does not fit in memory. Default true.

min_free_kb.description: Internal RAM, in kilobytes, that must stay free after the frame. Default 100, a conservative guess, not a measurement.

fonts.description: Which of the linked font families draw (fusuma-fonts). Every key is optional.

preset.description: A preset of fusuma-fonts' catalog: fusuma, material, legible, plex or noto. Default: the first one the build linked.

sans.description: The sans family's id (inter, roboto, atkinson-hyperlegible, ibm-plex-sans, noto-sans), over the preset's.

mono.description: The mono family's id (jetbrains-mono, roboto-mono, atkinson-hyperlegible-mono, ibm-plex-mono, noto-sans-mono), over the preset's.

sizes.description: Line heights of the glyph atlases the integer renderer draws with, read at build time (FUSUMA_SETTINGS). Default 10, 15 and 20.
